answer:
Done — I turned your “Spanish verbs” note into a phone-friendly flashcard page.

It now:
- Lets you tap to flip cards
- Marks verbs as “I know this” or “Still learning”
- Remembers your progress
- Shows unknown verbs first
- Supports Spanish → English or English → Spanish
- Keeps your original note table unchanged
